title: Normalized completed constant-complex pullback
statement: Let g:X→Y be any scheme morphism, R a commutative ring, and I an ideal. Given normalized reduction data eY,eX [def-a1-constant-complex-quotient-model] and a normalized finite comparison f [def-a1-constant-complex-base-change-data], there is normalized geometric reduction data: its completed coefficient map has the prescribed limit projections, its comparison is invertible with the balanced tensor formula, its pulled reductions have the scalar-unit formula on arbitrary sections, its finite reduction square commutes, and its comparison is natural in scalar chain maps. No invertibility of the completed coefficient map is assumed.

proof.text: Compose inverse images of the source limit projections with the constant coefficient comparisons, and use their quotient naturality to form a cone. Its limit lift is the completed coefficient map. The normalized scalar coefficient equations give the scalar square. Apply the realized pullback comparison to the two completed scalar realizations. Pull alpha by the module adjunction unit, restrict the target coefficient action along its limit projection, and transpose through the inverse-image/scalar-extension adjunction; linearity gives the exact scaled pulled-section formula. To check the reduction square, use injectivity of the two composed hom equivalences, reducing to constant unit generators. The alpha normalization and the supplied finite comparison normalization give the same finite constant section. Naturality is the naturality of the realized comparison applied termwise.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_completed_pullback_exists {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    {dY : FiniteTower Y I} {dX : FiniteTower X I}
    (eY : ReductionData Y I dY) (eX : ReductionData X I dX)
    (heY : eY.IsNormalized Y I) (heX : eX.IsNormalized X I)
    (f : FiniteComparison g I dY dX) (hf : f.IsNormalized g I) :
    ∃ e : GeometricReduction g I eY eX f, e.IsNormalized g I
